2ee53b877a1f7b1f38f4f083:
Hushfeed v0.28.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The headline is that automatic video advance actually works now. With it switched on, a fresh start of TikTok did nothing at all, because TikTok only builds the piece that does the scrolling once somebody opens the video panel and asks for it by hand, and everything here hangs off that piece. It gets built at launch now. A second problem sat behind it: the check for whether the feed was on screen asked TikTok's auto scroll indicator about itself, and TikTok keeps that hidden until scrolling is already running, so the answer was always no. Changing the session limit starts a fresh count instead of carrying the old one along.

Settings had a bad habit of needing a visit. Patches you selected now switch themselves on when the app launches, so search controls you use before ever opening Hushfeed settings work. Leaving an old settings page open no longer undoes a newer choice, and changing your font size or navigation mode keeps you on the page you were using. On a phone in dark mode with TikTok in its light theme, the settings screen used to leave a black band where the clock and battery live. It reads TikTok's theme first now.

Daily holds got most of the attention this time. A hold pauses the video underneath it and resumes only the one it paused, and only while that feed is still on screen. If another app owns the sound when the hold ends, the video waits for the sound to come back rather than resuming into silence. Holds survive a trip to settings and an activity restart, and the panel's lower edge follows TikTok's own tab row so Home and messages stay tappable.

Long presses were doing less than the settings claimed. The two copy choices were wired to double tap, whose settings never offered them, so nobody could reach them. Custom long-press actions now take precedence over TikTok's own 2x edge hold, and they run from the newer coordinate callback as well as the older gesture listener. Edge seeking was converting positions to the wrong scale, and the fixtures that should have caught it were using the same wrong conversion.

Saving got better at picking the right thing. Profile pictures try TikTok's largest image first, where before a 1080-pixel original could come down as a 300-pixel copy. A story long press reaches the story that's actually showing rather than the collection around it. Saving a video without its sound keeps the rotation, and on Android 6 through 9 a save refused for want of storage permission says so instead of failing quietly.

Comment search cleans up after itself. Turning it off takes the box out of a sheet that's already open and puts back the rows and reply controls it hid, and turning it back on works with the comments already loaded.

Also here: follow diagnostics reads the modern profile response and keeps each relationship with the account it belongs to. Hiding search suggestions now covers cached recommendations and returns to the search page. The block and Not interested buttons attach to the creator you're on as soon as you switch them on. Inbox options that are off leave TikTok's own decisions alone, and a Feature Gate Lab override no longer empties an array it was meant to keep.

Validation: 995 runtime tests passed locally, plus forty-five in the patches module. The bundle carries 70 patches and applied cleanly to the vendor APK. It is byte reproducible: two builds of this commit produce the same file. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.



Note, 2026-09-10: the .mpp and SHA256SUMS.txt on this release were replaced a few hours after it went out. The patches inside are identical, entry for entry. What was wrong is the build stamp in the bundle manifest, which records the commit the file was built from so anyone can rebuild it and get the same checksum. The first upload was built a couple of commits early, so it carried the wrong one and a rebuild from this tag produced a different hash. The file here now is built from the tagged commit. If you downloaded before the replacement and your checksum no longer matches, that is why, and downloading again will settle it.

## BannerHub v6 1.5.1-604

> ## ⚠️ Important — please read before installing
>
> **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.**
>
> - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**.
> - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**.
> - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline.
>
> **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch.
>
> Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**.
>
> **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

**Hotfix on top of `v1.5.0-604`** — drop-in update, stable keystore unchanged, installs in place. **18 APKs attached** (9 full + 9 Lite) + 3 `.rvp` bundles.

### What's fixed in 1.5.1-604

- **🪪 Imported / Epic / GOG games now launch from Beacon, ES-DE, RetroHRAI, NeoStation, and Daijishou.** Previously couldn't be launched from external front-ends — fixed. See the [front-end launcher setup guide](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-604-build/beacon-setup.md) for per-variant `am` commands and the intent contract.
- **🧰 New Banner Tools menu.** PC Vibration, GPU Spoof, Renderer, and Show Game ID are now grouped under one **Banner Tools** entry to keep the per-game menu tidy.

Everything else — the full v6 feature set, variants table, signing notes, and patches-applied list — is unchanged from [v1.5.0-604](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/releases/tag/v1.5.0-604).

### 📺 Video walkthroughs

- **Beacon** — <https://youtu.be/hyjjs-ffpw4?si=Lp6CCGhwFKGR0tAA> (also covers creating PC-import game `.txt` / `.iso` files with GameID numbers)
- **RetroHRAI** — <https://youtu.be/tcYGLLRtCPY?si=0oEWYZo-8QopFQey>

## Features
- Added a `Patches` settings entry, allowing direct access to the custom patch settings page from the bottom of the Gboard settings page.
- Added a settings preview image mechanism that supports long-pressing items in the settings page to view the actual preview images.
- Added the `Clipboard Retention` patch, allowing adjustment of clipboard retention time, item count limits, and preview line count, with support for showing creation time and expiry countdown.
- Added the `Settings Homepage Override` patch, allowing switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings styles.
- Added `Clipboard Entity Extraction`: enables `Clipboard > Show information extracted from recently copied text, such as addresses, phone numbers, and other items`.
- Added `Clipboard Item Edit`: shows `Edit` when long-pressing a clipboard item.
- Added `Grammar Checker`: enables `Text correction > Grammar check`.
- Added `Inline Suggestions`: enables `Text correction > Smart Compose`.
- Added `Key Shape Selection`: enables rounded keys in `Theme details > Key shape`.

## Build And Release
- Upgraded the Morphe toolchain and release-related dependencies.
- Upgraded the package versions of `app.morphe.patches` plugin, `morphe-patcher`, `Gradle wrapper`, `Smali`, `Gson`, and `semantic-release`.
- Changed the semantic-release backmerge package from `@saithodev/semantic-release-backmerge` to `@cleyrop-org/semantic-release-backmerge`.

## 功能
- 新增 `Patches` 設定入口，可直接從 Gboard 設定頁底部進入自訂 patch 設定頁。
- 新增設定頁預覽圖機制，支援在設定頁長按項目查看實際預覽畫面。
- 新增 `Clipboard Retention` patch，可調整剪貼簿保留時間、數量上限、預覽行數，並支援顯示建立時間與到期倒數。
- 新增 `Settings Homepage Override` patch，可切換新版或舊版 Gboard 設定樣式。
- 新增 `Clipboard Entity Extraction`：啟用 `剪貼簿 > 顯示從最近複製文字中攝取的資訊，例如地址、電話號碼和其他項目`。
- 新增 `Clipboard Item Edit`：長按剪貼簿項目時顯示`編輯`。
- 新增 `Grammar Checker`：啟用 `修正和建議 > 文法檢查` 。
- 新增 `Inline Suggestions`：啟用 `修正和建議 > 智慧撰寫` 。
- 新增 `Key Shape Selection`：啟用圓角按鍵，`主題詳情 > 按鍵形狀` 。

## 建置與發佈
- 升級 Morphe toolchain 與 release 相關依賴。
- 升級 `app.morphe.patches` plugin、`morphe-patcher`、`Gradle wrapper`、`Smali、Gson` 與 `semantic-release`套件版本。
- semantic-release backmerge 套件由 `@saithodev/semantic-release-backmerge` 改為 `@cleyrop-org/semantic-release-backmerge`。

Hushfeed v0.64.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It's a fix release with no new patches.

## What's changed

* Hidden right-column buttons now stay hidden on videos you open from a creator's profile, a hashtag or a sound (#47). Those videos play in a screen of their own, and only the main feed used to lose its Like, Save or Share button.
* Hide TikTok Shop also hides a LIVE that's selling while it streams (#46), in the feed and on Friends. Until now only Hide LIVE videos took those away, and that hides every LIVE.
* Screen time keeps counting after you come back from messages, a creator's video or Hushfeed's settings. Wait for a tap only stops the feed when you actually left TikTok. With the feed muted, opening the comments no longer pauses music from another app.
* The already-saved prompt opens on the screen you're looking at. Automatic saves keep TikTok's watermark when Remove watermark is off, and a story saved with its sound isn't reported as failed when only the sound ran out of space.
* Picking Pause Hushfeed in the settings search no longer closes TikTok. Search also finds rows that stay greyed out until another switch is on, and those rows now say which switch that is.
* Undo last restore or reset can be pressed a second time without losing what you changed after the restore.
* Only these caption languages understands three-letter codes like eng or spa. A clip shorter than a second can count as seen, and Clear all on the Inbox's suggested accounts works on 47.1.3.
* The Feature Gate Lab says why a change was refused and works with Switch Access and Voice Access.
* Diagnostic reports leave out network addresses, TikTok's regional server names and the video ids in saved file names.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/v0.64.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2335 runtime tests and 454 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs. Resource checks passed, with no unexpected manifest changes. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On a phone running TikTok 47.0.3, Like and its count stayed hidden on a video opened from a creator's profile and back in the feed. Pause Hushfeed opened from the settings search without closing TikTok, and the Inbox opened normally.

The selling LIVE fix follows TikTok's own shop flags on the LIVE room. If one still gets through, the diagnostic report's feed filter table will show which route delivered it.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.64.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.

# chmate-revanced v1.0.1

ChMate 0.8.10.241 のスレッドタイトル直上に残っていた広告領域を、高さゼロへ戻す修正版です。

## 修正内容

- `toolbarContentTop` から上方向へ Constraint の連鎖をたどり、複数レイアウト間で表示状態が切り替わる同一の最上部スロットを広告枠として検出
- 難読化クラス名や数値resource IDを固定せず、誤検出を避けるため複数レイアウトでの非表示実績、`wrap_content`、親上端への制約、tag未設定をすべて要求
- 検出した枠を `0dp`・`GONE` にし、実行時の再表示もruntime collapserが再度折りたためる限定tagを付与
- v1.0.0で修正したタイトル幅、上下それぞれの更新gesture、同IDポップアップ用タップ領域はそのまま保持

## 実測検証

- 端末: Pixel 10a / Android 17 / 1080×2424px
- ChMate: `0.8.10.241`
- 修正前: タイトル直上の広告コンテナ `bounds=[0,152][1080,291]`、追加高139px
- 修正後: 同コンテナはUIツリーに存在せず、タイトルView `bounds=[0,152][1080,247]`、広告由来追加高0px
- スレッドタイトルは画面全幅、スレッド一覧の下引き更新spinner、スレッド末尾の上引き更新、ID直接タップとID行空白タップの同IDポップアップを同一候補APKで再確認
- `0.8.10.165`、`0.8.10.179`、`0.8.10.202 dev`、`0.8.10.241` の4世代すべてへ同じ `.rvp` を適用し、resource / DEX再構築、zipalign、署名に成功

検証に使用した入手時ファイルの SHA-256（ファイル自体は配布しません）:


Hushfeed v0.57.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Block a creator and move on. The existing one-tap block button now skips to the next video as soon as TikTok confirms the block. A small Unblock button appears at the top left for up to two seconds. It reverses the original block, even after the video changes. You can also unblock later in TikTok's Privacy > Blocked accounts.

If you've already swiped away while the request is running, Hushfeed won't skip another video. Failed or unconfirmed requests don't advance the feed. Other Undo notices keep their existing recovery time. This improves the existing Block author button, with no extra patch or setting.

Validation: 1577 runtime tests passed locally. All 266 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks and script contracts. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks. Use 47.0.3 when patching.

The release-derived APK was tested on the S22 with the same signing key and preserved app data. Device checks exercised the actual button, native feed movement, compact notice, Undo, rejection and unconfirmed-result behavior using simulated responses. The notice stayed under two seconds at normal and 130% text size, with no clipped text. All checked settings were restored. No real accounts were blocked during testing. Server-side block persistence was not retested. The S25 wasn't updated because its signing key differs from the local test key.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

## What changed

Two ad and Tako surfaces that slipped past the feed filter, both reported on 0.40.0. Each turned out to reach the screen by a route the earlier hooks never saw, found from the reporters' diagnostic exports and the 46.2.3 fixture.

**Ads while scrolling a profile (#2).** Watching a creator's videos from their profile still showed ads, and every diagnostic export said the profile list was clean, 0 removed. The ads were never in that list. The profile's own video pager asks a separate ad endpoint of its own and splices the answer in between the creator's videos, after the list the filter already cleaned. That request is refused now while Remove feed ads is on, and every read of its response is emptied as a backstop. A ProfileAdResponse line in the export names the route if one ever gets through.

**The "Ask" bar under a video (#6).** The strip under some videos that read "Ask · <topic>" is gone with Hide Tako AI on. It looked like a Tako feature, but it is one of TikTok's ordinary bottom banners, drawn by the same view as the "Search" bar, which is why the four Tako hooks in 0.39.0 and 0.40.0 never touched it. Hide Tako AI now covers it along with the floating bubble, and the switch says so.

**Validation.** 1419 runtime tests and 225 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 90 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. Both fixes were checked on a Galaxy S22 on 46.2.3: with Remove feed ads on the profile pager refuses its ad request, and a control build that forced the request through confirmed the refusal is what stops the ads. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

## Gamehub 6.0.4 - BannerHub API - Patched

A patched build of XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.4 (`com.xiaoji.egggame`, versionCode 114) that removes the login requirement so games can be imported and used without an account, redirects the catalog API to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker, and ships **9 variants that install side-by-side on the same device**.

### 🔄 Base APK refresh from 6.0.2 → 6.0.4

Bumps the base APK from 6.0.2 (versionCode 112) to 6.0.4 (versionCode 114) and re-anchors every bytecode-keyed patch against the new build's R8-renamed class names. New on this base: the **`Offline component cache fallback`** patch ships in a stable for the first time (⚠ currently broken at runtime on 6.0.4 — see the Patches applied table below for what that means; online behavior unaffected). All 9 variants patched cleanly on the first run — no .0 → .1 hotfix needed.

*Curious about the patcher-side details?* The full 6.0.2 → 6.0.4 R8 letter delta + the NAV_INTERCEPTOR coroutine-continuation note live in [`gamehub_reports/GH604_LETTER_MAP.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-604-build/gamehub_reports/GH604_LETTER_MAP.md) and in the patch source comments under [`patches/src/main/kotlin/app/revanced/patches/gamehub/`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/tree/gamehub-604-build/patches/src/main/kotlin/app/revanced/patches/gamehub).

**Migrating from any earlier release:** uninstall the previously-installed BannerHub-ReVanced variant of the same name first — release-to-release the signing keystore changes (CI generates a fresh debug keystore each run), so Android refuses cross-release upgrades with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`. Within v1.0.0-604 itself, all 9 variants share signing and install side-by-side.

### ✅ Steam game launches now work end-to-end

v1.0.0-602's release notes carried a warning that the **standard Steam client** wouldn't launch games under the BannerHub catalog redirect — the workaround was to switch to the **Lightweight Steam client** in the per-game settings. **That warning no longer applies.** The BannerHub API Worker has been fixed server-side to serve a Steam-launch-compatible payload for both client variants, so the standard Steam client launches games successfully on this build (and on existing patched builds — the fix is server-side and retroactive). Pick whichever Steam client suits your title; both work.

> ⚠ **If your first Steam launch errors with `xtask install components failed`:** open that game's **PC game settings**, set the components manually (Wine prefix, DXVK, VKD3D, container, etc.) and — most importantly — make sure the **correct Steam client** is selected, then try to launch again. The error is a one-time setup hiccup on the first launch when components haven't been pinned per-game yet; once the per-game settings are filled in the launch succeeds.

### Source
- **Base APK**: `GameHub_6.0.4.apk` — the official 6.0.4 global build (versionCode 114), attached unmodified to [`base-apk-604`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/releases/tag/base-apk-604).
- **Patcher**: ReVanced CLI 6.0.0 + this repo's patch bundle, branch `gamehub-604-build`.
- **Catalog backend**: [`The412Banner/bannerhub-api`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-api) — Cloudflare Worker, deployed at `bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev`.
- **Repo**: https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced

### Variants

Nine APKs are produced from the same patch bundle, each with a different package name + launcher label so they install side-by-side. The `Original` variant **replaces** an installed GameHub; the rest install **alongside** the original.

| Variant | APK | Package | Launcher label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-Normal.apk` | `banner.hub` | GameHub |
| Normal (GHL) | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-Normal(GHL).apk` | `gamehub.lite` | GameHub |
| PuBG | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-PuBG.apk` | `com.tencent.ig` | GameHub PuBG |
| AnTuTu | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-AnTuTu.apk` | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | GameHub AnTuTu |
| alt-AnTuTu | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-alt-AnTuTu.apk` | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | GameHub AnTuTu |
| PuBG-CrossFire | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | GameHub PuBG CrossFire |
| Ludashi | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-Ludashi.apk` | `com.ludashi.aibench` | GameHub Ludashi |
| Genshin | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-Genshin.apk` | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | GameHub Genshin |
| Original | `GameHub-6.0.4-Patched-Original.apk` | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | GameHub |

### Patches applied

| Patch | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Bypass login** | Lets you launch straight into the home screen and import games without an account. |
| **Disable Firebase Crashlytics** | Removes the Crashlytics init block so the patched build doesn't crash on launch with `VerifyError`. |
| **Debug logging** | Marks the APK debuggable and adds logcat markers along the import code path for triage. |
| **File manager access** | Exposes a content provider so external file managers (MT Manager etc.) can browse GameHub's data dir without root. |
| **Rewrite custom permissions per variant** | Per-variant `com.xiaoji.egggame.permission.*` rewrite so two installed variants don't collide on Android 7+. |
| **Mute UI sounds** | Replaces the bundled menu/button click sounds with silent PCM. Game audio is untouched. |
| **Redirect catalog API** | Points the catalog API at the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker (`bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev`) for curated component delivery. Side benefit: per-game PC settings now render in both landscape and portrait. |
| **Prefix API path with /v6** | Prepends `v6/` to every relative API call so the Worker can serve 6.0-only response variants without affecting 5.x clients. |
| **Offline component cache fallback** ⚠ *currently broken on 6.0.4* | *Intended to let per-game pickers show your cached components when the device is offline.* Online behavior is unchanged, so this caveat only matters when you're offline — pickers will still show only the embedded built-in versions instead of the cached entries the patch was meant to surface. Investigation pending; safe to ignore unless you specifically rely on offline picker contents. |
| **Change package name** *(per variant)* | Renames the APK package per variant so all 9 variants install side-by-side. The `Original` variant keeps `com.xiaoji.egggame`. |
| **Change app name** *(per variant)* | Renames the launcher label per variant. |

*Per-patch mechanics, smali edits, structural anchors, and version-by-version letter maps live in the [README's Patches applied section](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-604-build/README.md#patches-applied) and the patch source comments under [`patches/src/main/kotlin/app/revanced/patches/gamehub/`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/tree/gamehub-604-build/patches/src/main/kotlin/app/revanced/patches/gamehub).*

### Notes

- The base APK is unmodified XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.4; only the bytecode/resources required by the patches above are touched.
- **A fresh install is required if a previous release is still installed.** Each release run generates a new debug keystore, so the signing certificate differs between releases and Android refuses the upgrade with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE` (signature mismatch). Uninstall the previous version of the same variant first, then install the new one. Within a single release, all 9 variants are signed with the same cert.
- Cover-art-on-import was fixed server-side in the BannerHub Worker on 2026-05-11 (worker deploy `5fd6c6a7…`) and applies retroactively to every existing patched build — no APK rebuild needed.
- The `.rvp` patch bundle and `.rve` extension files are also attached for use with `revanced-cli` directly.

## BannerHub v6 1.3.1-608 > ⚠️ **Read before installing — USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** BannerHub v6 is a **separate project** from BannerHub 3.7.x and BannerHub Lite (own package names, keystore, and backend) — they do **not** update over one another, and v6 is a **work in progress, barely tested**, with different game compatibility. Full details below. ⤵
⚠️ Important — separate projects & compatibility (click to expand) **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**
A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.8** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account) and redirects the catalog to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**. **9 APKs attached.** Steam game launches work end-to-end. > **No separate Lite builds on the 6.0.8 base.** XiaoJi's own −46% size pass plus the privacy/size strips folded into every variant make the full 6.0.8 build (~46 MB) smaller than the old 6.0.4 Lite — so a distinct Lite would strip nothing extra. The Lite concept is absorbed. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-608-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account. - **Custom catalog API** — the catalog is redirected to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker for **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** (mode + intensity) via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free — no `libevshim` / `LD_PRELOAD`. - **GOG integration** — sign in to GOG, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games in-app; they're added to your GameHub library and launch like any other PC game. HushThreads v0.0.2 is the first release. It has 6 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and every one of them is selected by default.

## What's in it

- **Hide ads** takes sponsored posts out of each page of the feed before Threads saves or shows it.
- **Sanitize sharing links** takes tracking tags such as `xmt` off the links Threads hands out when you copy or share a post.
- **Disable analytics** sends Threads' event log uploads to a port on your phone that nothing listens on, so they never leave it.
- **Remove the advertising ID** means Google Play services gives Threads zeros instead of your phone's ID.
- **Restore screens on re-signed builds** lets a patched Threads trust itself the way it trusts Meta's build.
- **HushThreads settings** opens from a long-press on the Threads icon. Each feature has its own switch, and you can pause everything, back up your switches and export a diagnostic report.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Add HushThreads as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
3. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads **449.0.0.54.82**, version code **511908382**.
4. Uninstall the stock Threads before you install the patched one, since Android won't put one over the other. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Known limitations

- Sign in with your Instagram username and password. Threads' offer to continue as the Instagram account already on your phone doesn't work on a patched Threads yet.
- Hide ads ran on a phone, but the test account wasn't shown a single ad, so it hasn't been seen taking a real one out. If an ad gets through, please open an issue with a diagnostic report.
- Automatic safe mode is covered by tests and hasn't been triggered on a phone. Pause was checked on one and works.

## Validation

368 runtime tests and 105 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 6 patches applied without forcing to Threads 449.0.0.54.82, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed. The same patch code, built one version earlier, was also patched and installed through Morphe Manager on an Android 16 phone. The settings opened from both entries there, and a username and password sign-in worked.

HushTelegram v0.0.11 has 55 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`) and the official Telegram beta 12.10.7 (`org.telegram.messenger.beta`), up from 25 in v0.0.9. Fifty-three are selected by default, and every new switch starts off. The two credential patches take your own values, so they stay off until you pick them.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** Local notification status has a new line for Telegram's answer to its latest push registration. It reads Accepted, Refused, or Refused with the error name Telegram's server sent back, and the diagnostic report carries the same line. Telegram throws a refusal away without saying anything, so until now a phone with a saved push token and no confirmed accounts had no way to show why. Telegram only asks again when an account isn't registered yet or its push token changes, so "None since Telegram started" is normal on a phone that's already set up.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide contacts on Telegram switch, off by default, takes the Your contacts on Telegram list off a short chat list, along with its heading and the loading rows shown while contacts sync. Chats, folders, contact sync and search don't change. With no chats at all, you get the welcome screen Telegram shows when none of your contacts use it. Turning it off or pausing HushTelegram brings the same rows back. A change shows up the next time Telegram rebuilds the chat list, and a restart always does.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide greeting stickers switch, off by default, takes away the sticker an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting, so a stray tap can't send it. The empty chat's text stays, and business introductions keep their sticker. Premium and paid-message notices, the sticker picker and sending don't change.
* **Telegram:** A new Use system font switch, off by default, draws Telegram's bold and italic text in your phone's own font instead of the Roboto files the app carries, so headings match the rest of the text on a phone with a custom font. Code blocks take the phone's monospace font. Some number displays and Instant View pages keep Telegram's fonts. A change takes effect after Telegram restarts.
* **Telegram:** A new AMOLED black switch, off by default, turns the screens of Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black, which looks deeper on an OLED screen. A patterned chat background shows its pattern over black. Message bubbles and pop-up menus keep the theme's colors, and a theme you've installed from a file stays as it is. A change takes effect after Telegram restarts.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide translate bar switch, off by default, takes the translate bar off the top of chats in another language. Translate is still in the chat's menu, and a chat you're translating keeps its bar so the original is one tap away.
* **Telegram:** A new Exact numbers switch, off by default, shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, so a channel reads 12,345 subscribers instead of 12.3K.
* **Telegram:** A new Reveal spoilers switch, off by default, shows spoiler text, photos and videos without making you tap them. View-once media and sensitive content keep their blur, and login codes from Telegram stay covered.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide keyboard on scroll switch, off by default, closes the keyboard as soon as you start scrolling through a chat.
* **Telegram:** A new Keep videos muted on volume keys switch, off by default, stops the volume keys from playing the video on screen with sound in a chat. They just change the volume.
* **Telegram:** A new Swipe back on profiles switch, off by default, lets a swipe to the right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back instead of flipping to the previous photo or tab.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide phone number switch, off by default, shows your own number as dots in the side menu, Settings, your profile and everywhere else Telegram displays it. Handy for screenshots. Other people's numbers stay visible.
* **Telegram:** A new Message times with seconds switch, off by default, adds seconds to the time on each message, like 9:41:27 PM.
* **Telegram:** A new Allow chat blur on slower phones switch, off by default, lets phones Telegram rates as slow turn on its blurred chat header and panels under Power saving.
* **Telegram:** A new Play voice messages one at a time switch, off by default, stops Telegram playing the next voice or video message in a chat when one ends.
* **Telegram:** A new Turn off haptic feedback switch, off by default, stops the vibration Telegram adds to taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Incoming calls and notifications still vibrate.
* **Telegram:** A new Turn off reaction effects switch, off by default, stops the fly-in and burst Telegram plays over the screen when you or someone else reacts. The reaction still lands on the message.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide folder tab counters switch, off by default, takes the unread counts off the folder tabs above the chat list. Chats stay unread.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide sender names when forwarding switch, off by default, starts each forward with Telegram's Hide sender's name option on. You can still turn it off before sending, and an article forward from an account without Premium keeps the sender, as Telegram requires.
* **Telegram:** A new Voice messages in the music player switch, off by default, opens Telegram's full music player when you tap the bar above a chat while a voice message plays, so you get the big seek bar and speed controls. Without it the tap jumps to the message, as before. View-once voice messages never open the player.
* **Telegram:** A new Silence people outside your contacts switch, off by default, lets a private message from someone who isn't in your contacts arrive quietly. You still get the notification, it just doesn't ring or buzz. Bots, reminders and Telegram's login codes keep their sound.
* **Telegram:** A new Disable pull to archive switch, off by default, keeps a hidden archive out of the chat list so pulling down doesn't bring it up. The chat list's menu gets an Archived chats entry, and a pinned archive stays where it is.
* **Telegram:** A new Start the camera on the rear lens switch, off by default, opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens each time instead of the lens you used last.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide gallery camera tile switch, off by default, takes the live camera tile out of the attachment menu's photo grid so it starts with your photos.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide time on stickers switch, off by default, takes the little time bubble off stickers and big animated emoji, read checks included. Every other message keeps its time.

## Install

2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram **12.10.6** from [telegram.org/android](https://telegram.org/android) by tapping Download Telegram (it saves as plain `Telegram.apk`), or the [official beta](https://telegram.org/dl/android/apk-public-beta) **12.10.7**, and patch it. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.9? Patch again and install over it with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram won't send you a login code, register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Use only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select **Use registered Telegram API credentials**, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.
7. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

766 runtime tests and 352 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints. All 55 patches applied without forcing to Telegram 12.10.6 and to the 12.10.7 beta, build 71239. The dependency advisory check passed. On an Android 16 phone, this build installed over the previous HushTelegram build and kept its data, and Local notification status showed Telegram's answer to the push registration by name.

3809959fdc88f0f5c7aefbe3: CrazyGames interstitial fix. Mid-game interstitial ads drove the same loading-overlay state machine as rewarded ads: the web waits for the interstitial Showed and Dismissed lifecycle events to dismiss the overlay. showInterstitial only resolved the call (firing neither event), so it hung. Interstitial events are named differently from rewarded (interstitialAdShowed/interstitialAdDismissed vs onRewarded*); the extension is generalized to fireAdEvents and now fires Showed+Dismissed for interstitial and Reward+Dismissed for rewarded. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.

HushMessenger v0.0.9 provides the patch bundle for Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 arm64 builds 346013387 and 346013440.

## Known startup limitation

Re-signed Messenger previously installed with the matching Facebook key but opened a blank first-run screen. An unchanged Morphe rebuild did the same. This release does not resolve that startup failure. Re-signed chats, calls and notification behavior remain unverified.

## Changes

The new read-only installation check verifies candidate and installed APK certificates before any phone changes. It reports installed-app signer mismatches, shared-permission owners and downgrades. API-specific rotated certificates and complete multiple-signer sets are checked; source stamps aren't app identities.

Stock S22 and S25 exchanged encrypted messages between two owned accounts. The S22 browser switch passed HTTP and HTTPS comparisons. Its original setting was restored, and both installed apps and sign-ins were preserved.

## Verification

- Twelve Kotlin tests and eleven Python tests pass. Ruff checks pass.
- Two clean local builds produced the same bundle checksum.
- Morphe Desktop 1.17.0 patched and signed the S25 APK off-device. Its manifest has 26 plus three renamed permission attributes and no old names.
- The altered-APK check stopped before output. The installation check passed the stock candidate and rejected a mismatched fixture and the rebuilt APK without installing either.

Download [patches-0.0.9.mpp](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.9/patches-0.0.9.mpp) and [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.9/SHA256SUMS.txt). The .mpp is a patch bundle; bring your own supported stock APK. Installation and certificate-check instructions are in the [README](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/tree/v0.0.9#check-a-signed-apk-before-installation).
